statement: A legal person whose address is abroad must designate a contact person in Estonia to whom its procedural documents and declarations of intent can be delivered; only a notary, advocate, law firm, sworn auditor, audit firm, the tax representative of a non-resident, or a licensed trust and company service provider may be designated, and delivery to the registered contact person counts as delivery to the legal person (Commercial Register Act § 24(2), (4), (7)).
caveat: Since 2023-02-01 the duty keys on the company's registered address rather than on where the management board sits: the former Commercial Code § 63¹ contact-person rule was repealed, and a company registered in Estonia may now carry a foreign address. The contact person's term is registered, and the data drop out of the register automatically when the term expires (§ 24(6)).
